authority.summary: Drupal core's default.settings.php documents config_sync_directory as the setting that names a site's configuration directory, which is what makes a second candidate root ambiguous rather than harmless.

finding.assertion: More than one candidate exported configuration root is present.

conclusion.candidate: No configuration root could be selected.

finding.evidence_explanation: Exported configuration root selection was observed as ambiguous, meaning more than one candidate root was found and none was chosen.
finding.human_title: The exported configuration root is ambiguous
limitations: While the root is ambiguous, no configuration evidence exists at all, and the absence of other configuration findings means nothing.

remediation.guidance: Identify which directory config_sync_directory points at and remove or exclude the other candidate export, so configuration analysis has one authoritative root.

scope.notes: Exported configuration directories are a Drupal 8-and-later mechanism.
